parameters.name: AttackType
parameters.description:
The attack type of the intrusion prevention event. Valid values:

- **1**: anomalous connection

- **2**: command execution

- **3**: brute-force attack

- **4**: scanning

- **5**: other

- **6**: information leakage

- **7**: DoS attack

- **8**: overflow attack

- **9**: web attack

- **10**: trojan backdoor

- **11**: virus and worm

- **12**: mining

- **13**: reverse shell

> If you do not specify this parameter, all attack types are queried.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
